activities_top.name: Sendai Castle Ruins - Aoba Castle Exhibition Hall
activities_top.hours: Apr-Oct 9:00-16:20 (last entry 15:50); Nov-Mar 9:00-15:40 (last entry 15:10); may close earlier depending on season and weather

closed.irregular: Open all year except a few maintenance days per year

activities_top.name: Matsushima Bay Island Cruise (Niomaru course)
activities_top.hours: Departures hourly 9:00-16:00; Nov to mid-Mar 10:00-15:00; loop about 50 min

activities_top.name: Osaki Hachimangu Shrine
activities_top.hours: Grounds open freely; amulet office 9:00-17:00; prayers 9:00-16:00 without reservation

activities_top.name: Zuiganji Temple (Matsushima)
activities_top.hours: Opens 8:30; closing time varies by month (about 16:30-17:00 in summer, 15:00-15:30 in Dec-Jan); last entry 30 min before closing

editions.note: Planned dates per City of Sendai; Jozenji-dori area. 2026 lighting hours not yet published at research time (2025: Mon-Thu 19:00-22:00, Fri-Sat 18:00-22:00, Sun 18:00-21:00, Dec 24-25 18:00-22:00). Sendai Christmas Market in Nishikicho Park Dec 4-25.

events.name: Sendai Tanabata Festival
events.recurrence: yearly, every August 6-8 (fireworks festival on the evening of August 5)

editions.note: Fixed by rule (Aug 6-8 every year); the Aug 5 fireworks date for 2027 was not confirmed
